title: Optimization by Simulated Annealing
relevance: Seminal paper introducing simulated annealing for combinatorial optimization, establishing the Metropolis acceptance criterion and geometric cooling schedule that form the core of this module's search strategy.

title: Energy Landscapes: Applications to Clusters, Biomolecules and Glasses
relevance: Comprehensive treatment of energy landscape theory including disconnectivity graphs, basin volumes, and funnel structure; provides the conceptual framework for analyzing the topology of the Collatz delay surface.

title: Global optimization by basin-hopping and the lowest energy structures of Lennard-Jones clusters containing up to 110 atoms
relevance: Introduces the basin-hopping algorithm combining local minimization with Monte Carlo moves; directly informs the restart-and-perturb strategy used to escape local delay optima.
